anthropic.support_note: First-party Anthropic models routed through the locally managed CLIProxyAPI OAuth gateway; this transport path is not officially supported by Anthropic.

deepseek.support_note: DeepSeek Anthropic endpoint (Flash probes 2026-08-12; Pro GA accepted 2026-08-19): x-api-key, 1M, thinking default-on. Pro max thinking + model-selected tool use work when tool_choice is omitted; named forced tool_choice returns 400. Text-only; cache_control ignored; server MCP blocks unsupported. Listing: Bearer OpenAI-shape GET /models (Anthropic path 404). China-based, no region pinning.

kimi.support_note: Third-party Claude-compatible route through the local gateway; locally validated experimental transport, not officially supported by Anthropic.

meta.support_note: Meta Model API Anthropic Messages adapter: the SDK appends /v1/messages to https://api.meta.ai; Bearer META_CLAUDE_API_KEY. Effort via output_config.effort low/medium/high/xhigh (NO max); thinking always on (disabled -> 400); rejects stop_sequences/top_k/unknown top-level fields; named forced tool_choice -> 400; extra stop_reason 'refusal'. Contributor variant: outputs may train Meta products (privacy), 100 RPM cap. Route acceptance live-probe-gated.

openai.support_note: Third-party Codex route through the local OAuth gateway; locally validated experimental transport, not officially supported by Anthropic or OpenAI.

openrouter.support_note: OpenRouter Anthropic skin (aggregator; no prompt logging by default, no training-provider routing unless opted in). Grok 4.6 exact-slug high/xhigh thinking + tool use and xhigh stream ordering were live-verified 2026-08-19. Listing: public OpenAI-shape GET /api/v1/models (no key). Moving alias ~x-ai/grok-latest currently resolves 4.6 but is not trusted: D3 forbids hidden moving authority outside record+catalog.
